**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329)
Thank you much for Giftie.

She looks very pretty and I like her picture.

Yes, we will, if we can, have a Christmas [Barnacle](../others.html#89). I have one capitally illustrated paper for it already from [Sparrow Hawk](../persons.html#97).

Shall we send out the Questions for December, or January, I mean shall they go New Years day, or the month before?
I think we are to have a new [Gosling](../others.html#104) -
[Emma Butler](../persons.html#822)
Wantage Vicarage
Berks.

Would you send her the rules, and the names, omitting alas [Turkscap](../persons.html#1520), who has grown too busy.

Have you seen her pretty story, ‘Nigel Bartram’s Ideal’ a shilling book of Warne’s

yours affectionately

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
